introHtml: Polyester patches and buttons offer a durable, vibrant option for branding that stands up to repeated wear and washing. Unlike paper stickers, polyester versions resist tearing and fading, making them ideal for uniforms, bags, and outdoor gear. Add your logo with embroidery or woven detail for a professional finish that lasts. Perfect for safety teams, event staff, or promotional giveaways.
